# passenger

**Tag**: web

## 简介

A modern web server and application server for Ruby, Python and Node.js, optimized for performance, low memory usage and ease of use.

## 官网

- 主页: https://www.phusionpassenger.com/
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/phusion/passenger
- 文档: https://www.phusionpassenger.com/docs/
